column1: # Game profile of Cricket 24 (Switch, base game 1.0.0 = v0)
# Big Ant Studios' engine with Wwise, SDK 16.2.3. Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and brought up on the Mac (docs/agents)
# main imports nothing from subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie) that the host does not supply; the game loads one NRO (nro/party.nro) through nn::ro
# The NPDM declares no system resource: main sets a heap of at most the pool less 64 MB, 3.13 GB in the 3.25 GB heap region of the 4 GB layout ([mem] heap 3.13 GB)
# every shader is in data/<xx>/<hash> files named in data/data-0.blobset.nx.log; the pack is shaders.blob.nx (docs/reference/shaders.md, Big Ant's chunked zstd files and shader pack)
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory
